patch.description: Open-weight Qwen3-Next thinking model with 80B total and 3B active parameters, hybrid attention, and tool-calling support.
patch.notes: 80B total and 3B active are nominal developer counts for this exact thinking checkpoint. Hybrid attention combines Gated DeltaNet and gated attention with MoE. Native context is 262144. Release month is September 2025; indexed announcement displays September 10 and API table says September 11.

summary: Confirms the existing 80B total/3B active counts, MoE architecture, native context and capabilities. Adds Apache-2.0, upgrades parameter provenance to primary_source, and grounds the description. Retains September 2025 precision because announcement and API release dates differ.
